items.title: Muggsy Spanier Interview, 1961-02-02
items.q: I pitched a game for Harry James' team one time when they were at the Astro Hotel in New York.

ctx.x: Remember Harry James? They used to have a ball team. Yeah. Some people say it's more of a ball team than a band.

I pitched a game for Harry James' team one time when they were at the Astro Hotel in New York. We played the New York City High School Champions. They only beat us about two to one. Oh, really? Yes, we did. Good game. I pitched about six innings. I had it.
Can you tell us any more about Joe Oliver or anything? What impressed you about his style or was it different than the music around Chicago or something?
